name: peoplesoft-pia
title: PeopleSoft pages with Playwright
description: Testing PeopleSoft Internet Architecture (PIA) pages with Playwright for Python: how classic and Fluid pages are put together (the TargetContent frame, /psp/ and /psc/ URLs, RECORD_FIELD$row ids, server round trips, toolbar buttons and message boxes whose ids start with #) and how to drive them reliably. A hand-written starter from general PeopleSoft knowledge: ids and behaviour vary by PeopleTools version, so verify on your pages, extend it with your team's own test scripts (hobkin-lore build), and note what differs.
sources: general PeopleSoft knowledge: verify on your PeopleTools version
